source_law.title: Traffic controlled by official traffic-control devices (12)(a)
source_law.text: Whenever signals are placed over the individual lanes of a highway, the signals indicate, and apply to drivers of vehicles, as follows: A downward-pointing green arrow means that a driver facing the signal may drive in any lane over which the green signal is shown.
